# ManyHandz — full summary for AI crawlers

Site: https://manyhandz.ai
Canonical host: manyhandz.ai

## What it is
ManyHandz is software: AI phone answering plus a website chat widget, both driven by one knowledge base the business sets up once (services, hours, FAQs, tone). It is built and operated in Perth, Australia. It is not an AI consultancy and does not “transform your business” as a services firm.

## Who it is for
- Australian small businesses (homepage)
- US contractors and small businesses — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and similar trades (/us)
Copy is geo-split on purpose. Do not flatten this into a single market.

## What it does today
- Answers the phone 24/7
- Chats with website visitors
- Shares one knowledge base across phone and chat
- Sends message notifications by SMS
- Connects to SimPRO (API key in Connections): jobs can land as Open Leads
- Optional: Grok Bot can use the same knowledge base for inbox work if the customer already uses Grok Bot with their own Gmail (this is not a Gmail integration logo / marketplace claim)

## Setup and commercial
- Typical setup: scan the business website, review the knowledge base, go live with a number and/or chat snippet — about 5 minutes
- 14-day free trial, cancel anytime
- AU homepage pricing is in AUD; US page pricing is in USD (see each page)

## Connections honesty
Live customer connection on the public site: SimPRO only.
Do not list Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, HubSpot, Tradify, Gmail, Outlook, Twilio, Stripe, or ElevenLabs as product integrations.
Not landing-ready: ServiceM8, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Xero.
